column10: NOTES
Verified on page
Decoded from Cloudflare obfuscation, verified

CAUTION: info@sakaitakayukiknives.com IS PRINTED on their own contact page, but the domain sakaitakayukiknives.com has NO MX RECORD (confirmed across 3 independent DNS resolvers) - mail sent to it will bounce even though the address looks legitimate. This is a real trap: always MX-check even an on-page address. Real, live website confirmed (Cloudflare-hosted). Recommend using their contact FORM instead of the printed email, or reaching out via a listed retailer.
Verified on page; sheet had info@yoshiiroknife.com (misspelled, dead domain)
Verified: NO email on either kaiusa.com or shun.kaiusa.com contact pages. Phone 503-682-1966 / 800-325-2891. Social: facebook.com/shuncutlery, instagram.com/shuncutlery

VERIFIED FAKE SITE FLAGGED: sheet's tamanishikirice.com uses placeholder "555" phone and "1234 Rice Field Lane" fake address - not the real company. Tamanishiki is actually a JFC International brand. JFC publishes no email, form + phone +1 323-721-6100. Social: facebook.com/JFCInternational, instagram.com/jfcinternational
Verified on page. Williams, CA grower/packer. Sales agent Icrest International also lists info@icrest-llc.com

Verified: Shirakiku is a Wismettac Asian Foods brand. No email on Wismettac's contact page - web form only. Dedicated brand social: instagram.com/shirakikubrand. Parent: facebook.com/wismettacsake, linkedin.com/company/wismettac-asian-foods
Verified: Sekka is a JFC International brand (same as Tamanishiki). No email published, form + phone +1 323-721-6100. Note: sheet's sekkarice.com does not exist.

From Aug research: press@dassai.com reported across multiple independent sources incl. an EIN Presswire release; site itself rate-limits automated verification. Sheet's info@dassai.us has NO MX record - guaranteed bounce, do not use. Sister addresses: sales@dassai.com, info@dassai.com. US entity: DASSAI USA INC, Hyde Park NY.

From Aug research: press@hakkaisan.co.jp confirmed, plus named contacts Shinsuke Sasagawa / Shoko Baba (International Marketing, handle English inquiries). Sheet's info@hakkaisan.com is unverified/likely wrong department.
Verified: contact form only, no email address on page. Tendo, Yamagata brewery.

Sheet's gekkeikanusa.com does NOT EXIST. Real US site is us.gekkeikan.com, publishes no email - phone +1 (916) 293-7040 only. Social: instagram.com/gekkeikansake_usa. Sheet's info@gekkeikan.com is unverified.

Corporate site hakutsuru-sake.com has NO email (form only, 403 to some fetches). hakutsuru-america.com MX verified live (mx1c38.carrierzone.com) so info@ can receive mail. Social: facebook.com/hakutsuru.sake.usa, instagram.com/hakutsuru.sake.usa. Sheet's hakutsurusa.com does not exist.

Sheet's press@beamsuntory.com is NOT published anywhere I could verify. Real dedicated media page exists at suntory.com/newsroom/mediacontact but blocks all automated access (403) - a human needs to open it in a browser. Social: facebook.com/BeamSuntory, instagram.com/beamsuntory.
Sheet's nikkawhisky-usa.com does NOT EXIST. Nikka (part of Asahi Group) publishes no email; route via Asahi Group Holdings customer form. Social: instagram.com/nikkawhiskyglobal.

Genuinely hard target: small distillery, no discoverable official website with a contact page in English. Sheet's ichibey.jp does not exist. Only verified route is Facebook (ChichibuDistillery). Flag as low-confidence - recommend approaching via a US importer/distributor instead (e.g. their listed importers on retailer sites) rather than cold-emailing.
Verified: correct real domain (sheet's arita-porcelain-lab.com does not exist). Form only, checked raw HTML too - no email anywhere on site. Phone 81-955-43-2224.

Real domain e-kihara.co.jp (sheet's kiharaincorporated.com does not exist). Search engines report kmatsu@e-kihara.co.jp but I could NOT verify it on any page - checked contact and English pages directly, no email in the HTML. DO NOT treat as confirmed. Phone 81-955-43-2325 is the safe fallback. US distributor AMEICO (ameico.com) carries the line but their contact page 404'd.

Verified: real domain narumi.co.jp (sheet's narumi.com is unrelated/does not exist for this purpose). No email anywhere on their office-location or contact pages. DOES have a USA sales office: +1-310-856-8560 - best fallback for an English-speaking contact.

Verified on page - three addresses listed: info@tokyosaikai.com (Japan/corporate), sales@saikaiusa.com (US), info@europesaikai.com (Europe). Using the US one since Chris is targeting US-reachable sponsors. Sheet's hasamiporcelain.com does not exist.
Verified on page. 1616/arita japan is a brand of Momota Touen Co. Sheet's 1616arita.com does not exist.
Real domain located (sheet's kawai-chopsticks.com does not exist - that's a retailer product tag, not the maker). Kawai Co Ltd, Obama City, Fukui. Contact is a web form, no email visible.
Verified on page (with a note to remove a formatting space before "jp" for mobile). Real domain hyozaemon.co.jp (sheet's hyozaemon.com is unrelated).
Real domain located via Japanese-language search: hashi.co.jp (sheet's yamachiku.jp does not exist). Kumamoto bamboo chopstick maker. Contact page exists but no email visible in fetched content.

GENUINELY NO DISCOVERABLE OFFICIAL WEBSITE for this Nagano/Kiso woodworking maker, in English or Japanese search. Only retailer/reseller pages exist (Musubi Kiln, Globalkitchen Japan, Nihon Ichiban). Sheet's miyabi-japan.co.jp does not exist. Recommend approaching via a US retailer that carries the line, or dropping this target - it may not be a distinct company reachable directly.

Real domain ohashi-sunlife.com (sheet's sunlife-inc.co.jp does not exist). Company profile page has only physical addresses (HQ + Tokyo design studio), no email or phone found anywhere on the English site.
Verified: real domain yama-roku.net (sheet's yamaroku4.com does not exist). Shodoshima Island, Kagawa. Phone 0879-82-0666 only, no email or form found.

CRITICAL: sheet's pr@kikkoman.com IS FABRICATED - confirmed in Aug research to exist nowhere on any Kikkoman property. Their US site has NO email at all, form only. Phone (415) 956-7750. Social: facebook.com/kikkomanusa, instagram.com/kikkomanusa. DO NOT use pr@kikkoman.com under any circumstances.

CRITICAL: sheet's yamasa.org is a JAPANESE LANGUAGE SCHOOL, completely unrelated to the soy sauce company. Real site is yamasausa.com (Salem, OR brewery), publishes no email - phone (503) 363-8550. Social: facebook.com/yamasaUSAsoysauce, instagram.com/yamasausa.

IMPORTANT: yugeta-soy-sauce.com (which looks official) displays "info@mysite.com" - an UNEDITED WIX TEMPLATE PLACEHOLDER, not a real address. Do not use it. The real site is yugeta.com; its contact page is a form only, no email visible. Sheet's yugeta-shoyu.com does not exist.
Verified on page. Tatsuno City, Hyogo - usukuchi (light) soy sauce since 1879. Sheet's suehiro-shoyu.com does not exist.

FLAG FOR CHRIS: could not confirm what specific company "Inoue Jozo" refers to. There is an Inoue Shoyu in Okuizumo, Shimane (inoue-shoyu-shop.com) - different region than the Yuasa/Wakayama "birthplace of soy sauce" story this category implies. There is a separate Yuasa Shoyu (yuasasyouyu.co.jp) and a Marushinhonke (yuasa-marushin.net) actually based in Yuasa. Sheet's inouejozo.co.jp does not exist. Need the source Chris used to identify which company was intended before I can verify a real contact.
Sheet's kinjirushi.com does NOT EXIST. Real US site kinjirushiusa.com (Torrance, CA), publishes no email - phone (310) 214-0441. Social: facebook.com/kinjirushiusa, instagram.com/kinjirushiwasabi.
Verified (decoded from Cloudflare obfuscation). Operating name is Wasabi Essentials Ltd / brand Pacific Coast Wasabi, Vancouver BC. Sheet's pacificcoastwasabi.com does not exist.
Verified: real domain confirmed (matches sheet). No email on the contact page - form + phone +1 415 205 5797 only.

Verified on page - THREE addresses found: kanko@ (tourism), koho@ (PR/media - use this one), webshop@ (online store). Note the live domain is daiowasabi.CO.JP not .jp as in some listings - both may work but co.jp confirmed. Sheet's daio-wasabi.co.jp does not exist (missing the dash placement).

FLAG FOR CHRIS: "Utogi" is a REGION in Shizuoka City known as the birthplace of wasabi cultivation, not a company name. The only business found there is Utsurogi, a restaurant/souvenir shop (054-298-2900), not obviously a wasabi producer/exporter. Sheet's utogi-wasabi.jp does not exist. This looks like the same naming-fabrication pattern as Inoue Jozo (#70) - a real place name turned into a fake company name. Need clarification on what company was actually intended.

Sheet's yamamoto-nori.co.jp does NOT EXIST and appears to conflate a generic name with Yamamotoyama, the actual major US nori/tea importer. Verified info@yamamotoyama.com on their real contact page. Pomona, CA. (800) 800-8327.
Real domain found: niconico-nori.CO.JP (sheet's niconico-nori.com does not exist - wrong TLD). Osaka nori maker. Phone 0120-253-111, form only, no email visible.
Sheet's yamamotoyama-usa.com does NOT EXIST. Real domain is yamamotoyama.com, info@ verified on page. NOTE: row 105 (Premium Japanese Tea) is the SAME COMPANY - one pitch covers both categories.

Verified: real domain confirmed. Shizuoka-based (also known for Sea Chicken tuna brand). Form only, no email visible on corporate site. Sheet's hagoromo-foods.co.jp is a near-miss (extra hyphen) that does not resolve.

CRITICAL CORRECTION: sheet's press@mizkan.com is NOT the real address - it is not published anywhere on Mizkan's site. The REAL dedicated PR & Media Relations page publishes Communications@mizkan.com. This is one of the strongest hits on the whole list - use it, not what the sheet has.

Sheet's info@marukan-usa.com is NOT published anywhere on the real site - Marukan publishes no email at all, form only. Phone 562-630-6060. Social: facebook.com/MarukanVinegar. Paramount, CA and Griffin, GA breweries.
Real company located: "Tajima Jozosho" (但馬醸造所), part of Hinode Holdings. Real domain tajimajozo.co.jp (sheet's tajima-su.co.jp does not exist). Phone 079-669-1100, form only, no email visible.
Real domain sennari-oochi.com (sheet's sennari.jp has no MX, cannot receive mail). Hiroshima-based since 1927. Phone +81-82-810-300, form only, no email visible.

DUPLICATE: this is the SAME COMPANY as row 91 (Mizkan) under a different product-line name. Same correction applies: Communications@mizkan.com, not press@mizkan.com. Do not pitch as two separate sponsors.

Verified on page. Kakuida is a black vinegar brand; essan.com appears to be its English-facing sales site (Odawara, Kanagawa producer Chinriu Honten reported separately but not confirmed on this page - using what's verified). Sheet's kakuida.co.jp does not exist.

CATEGORY ERROR IN SHEET: Naogen (直源) is a SOY SAUCE company in Kanazawa, Ishikawa - not a vinegar producer at all. It was miscategorized under "Sushi Vinegar." Real domain naogen.co.jp (sheet's naogen.jp does not exist). Form only, no email found. Flag for Chris: this may need to move to the soy sauce list, or be replaced with an actual vinegar maker.
Real domain kohno-honten.co.jp (sheet's kono-su.co.jp does not exist). NOTE: located in Maniwa, OKAYAMA prefecture, not Wakayama as sheet implies. Phone 0867-42-0102, form only, no email found.
DUPLICATE: same company as row 87 (Premium Nori) - Yamamotoyama covers both nori and tea. One pitch, not two. Sheet's yamamotoyama-usa.com does not exist.
Real domain confirmed (sheet's horii-shichimeien.co.jp does not exist). Uji, Kyoto matcha maker since 1832. Form only, no email visible.
Sheet's marketing@itoen.com is not published anywhere I could verify. The real, verified address on their contact page is customerservice@itoen.com. Phone 888-832-7832, Irving TX.
Real domain global.tokichi.jp / tokichi.jp (sheet's nakamura-tokichi.com does not exist). Uji, Kyoto. Two separate contact forms (online store vs. main store), no email visible on either.

Verified on page. Yame, Fukuoka gyokuro/matcha producer. NOTE the email domain (hoshinocha.com, no hyphen) differs slightly from the website domain (hoshino-cha.com, with hyphen) - both appear to be controlled by the same company. Sheet's hoshino-seichaen.co.jp does not exist.
